verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਵੈਦ ਪੁਛੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: rogee maanas hoi kai firadhaa baahale vaidh puchha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Suffering disease man goes about asking for treatment from many a physician.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਚੈ ਵੈਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗੀ ਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kachai vaidh na jaananee vedhan dhaaroo rogee sa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Since the inexperienced physician does not know the problem of the patient as well as the medicine for the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੋ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਇੜ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: horo dhaaroo rog hor hoi pachaiR dhukh saha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The suffering person goes suffering more and more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ ਘਰਿ ਦਾਰੂ ਦਸੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: aavai vaidh suvaidh ghar dhaaroo dhasai rog laha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: If a mature physician is found, he prescribes the right medicine, which removes the malady.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਪਥੁ ਖਟਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਸਾਉ ਚਖੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)jam rahai na khai path khaTaa miThaa saau chakha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Now, if the patient does not follow the prescribed discipline and goes on to eat everything sweet and sour, the physician is not to be blamed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦਾਰੂ ਵੈਦ ਨੋ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਧੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhos na dhaaroo vaidh no vin sa(n)jam nit rog vadha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: For want of temperance the malady of the patient goes on increasing day and night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇ ਬਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kapaT sanehee hoi kai saadhasa(n)gat vich aai baha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: If a cheat even comes to the holy congregation and sits there.
He being controlled by wickedness gets perished in his duality.
